recipe: Use this recipe for conversational employee onboarding. Do not discover alternative schemas or trial-run writes.

Before drafting normal create/update JSON plans, run business schema <resource> --workflow create|update for the resource-specific plan contract. Prefer business schema over reading long hr-schema docs when drafting normal write plans.
This is a create workflow: run business preview employee before confirmation, then business create employee after confirmation. Do not use preview-update/update for a new employee.

Use one flat JSON plan object or a records array; do not try multiple wrapper formats. Write exactly one JSON plan under .nanobot_channel_webui/runtime-inputs/<chat_id>/ from the user natural-language request.
User confirmation must be requested only after the JSON plan has been written and the preview or preview-update command has succeeded. Do not ask for confirmation from the raw user request alone.

Show a business confirmation summary derived from the internal preview result, including records, matched items, skipped items, field diffs, and risks when present. Do not expose CLI, preview, 预览, or 系统预览 in visible replies, including multi-resource workflows.
After confirmation, run business create employee --input <same-plan.json>.
The create command performs the database write and internal verification against the same JSON plan; use the create result as the troubleshooting evidence if verification fails.
A successful create result must include verification.ok true.
A successful create/update/delete result is sufficient; do not run extra get/query/analyze readback unless the user explicitly asks for it.

capabilities.title: HR 业务数据更新
recipe: Use the update workflow only when the user wants to modify an existing HR business record.

Do not use this workflow to create new employee-related records. New contracts, performance reviews, insurance changes, personnel changes, disciplinary records, and seal usage records use preview/create instead.

Use one flat JSON plan object or a records array; do not try multiple wrapper formats. Include company and enough business keys to uniquely match the existing record, then include only fields the user wants to change.
Run business preview-update <resource> --input <plan.json> and summarize matches, skipped records, and field diffs in natural language.
User confirmation must be requested only after the JSON plan has been written and the preview or preview-update command has succeeded. Do not ask for confirmation from the raw user request alone.

Show a business confirmation summary derived from the internal preview result, including records, matched items, skipped items, field diffs, and risks when present. Do not expose CLI, preview, 预览, or 系统预览 in visible replies, including multi-resource workflows.
Wait for explicit user confirmation.
After confirmation, run business update <resource> --input <same-plan.json>; update includes verification.
A successful create/update/delete result is sufficient; do not run extra get/query/analyze readback unless the user explicitly asks for it.
If update fails, do not delete or recreate the record as a fallback. Report the failure or ask the user for a unique matching field; delete and recreate requires a separate explicit confirmation.

capabilities.title: 组织和部门导入
recipe: Use this recipe for conversational organization or department creation. Do not discover hidden schemas or trial-run confirmed writes.

This is a create workflow: run business preview organization before confirmation, then business create organization after confirmation. Do not use preview-update/update for a new organization or department.
Use one flat JSON plan object or a records array; do not try multiple wrapper formats. Write exactly one JSON plan under .nanobot_channel_webui/runtime-inputs/<chat_id>/ before calling any command.
For adding a department to an existing company, use {"company":"公司全称","departments":[{"name":"部门名称"}]}. Put unsupported business notes in summary/source; the department table stores company and name.
Run business preview organization --input <plan.json> to validate what would be created or already exists.
User confirmation must be requested only after the JSON plan has been written and the preview or preview-update command has succeeded. Do not ask for confirmation from the raw user request alone.

Show a business confirmation summary derived from the internal preview result, including records, matched items, skipped items, field diffs, and risks when present. Do not expose CLI, preview, 预览, or 系统预览 in visible replies, including multi-resource workflows.
After confirmation, run business create organization --input <same-plan.json>.
The create command performs internal verification against the same JSON plan and must return verification.ok true; use the create result as the troubleshooting evidence if verification fails.
A successful create/update/delete result is sufficient; do not run extra get/query/analyze readback unless the user explicitly asks for it.
